description: Get an overview of all email accounts: total accounts, unread counts, message totals, and each account's sender identities (id, email, name) for email_compose `from`. Optionally filter to a single account or include per-folder breakdown. Message dates: `date` is UTC, `dateLocal` is the user's local time.

accountId.description: Optional: limit stats to a specific account ID

name: email_stats
